```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    constructor
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    left
    exact ⟨1, by rw [pow_one, h1]⟩
    right
    obtain ⟨c, h3, h4⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_of_pow_eq_pow (n ≠ 0 ∨ n ≠ 0) (by rw [h2]; exact pow_inj' _ _ _)
    exact ⟨c, h3⟩
```
